SELECT c.public_id, c.username, c.display_name, c.client_code, c.party_role, c.customer_code_prefix, c.customer_code_mode, c.provisioning_source, c.status, c.remark, c.contact_email, c.created_by, COALESCE(c.responsible_agent_id, 0) AS responsible_agent_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, creator.display_name AS created_by_display_name, owner.display_name AS responsible_agent_display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cp_customer_shipment_access a WHERE a.customer_id = c.id) AS shipment_count, employee.id AS employee_user_id, employee.username AS employee_username, employee.display_name AS employee_display_name FROM cp_customers c LEFT JOIN cp_users creator ON creator.id = c.created_by LEFT JOIN cp_users owner ON owner.id = c.responsible_agent_id
LEFT JOIN cp_customer_employee_assignments assignment ON assignment.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN cp_users employee ON employee.id = assignment.employee_user_id AND employee.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.party_role IN ('SHIPPER', 'CONSIGNEE')
AND 1 = 1
AND c.responsible_agent_id = #{scope.userId}
AND assignment.employee_user_id = #{scope.userId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
